# Luis Reche

> Applied AI Engineer in Palma, Spain. I use LLMs and coding agents to ship software faster, with a human in the loop: I review and approve what ships. I build the whole product: backend, web, mobile, desktop and infrastructure.

## Experience

- Applied AI Engineer at Agentero, Apr 2026 to present. I own marketplace features and critical internal tooling end to end. Infrastructure on Google Cloud, backend services in Go and the marketplace interface in Next.js.
- Freelance software engineer for SocialPro, 2025 to present. I designed and built socialpro.es, a brand portal and the first internal CRM, and replaced the WordPress site of Piroboom, a client of the agency.
- Freelance product engineer at RecheDev, 2021 to present. ClipHub, built for SocialPro as their software consultant, and Berrus, another team's browser role-playing game.

## Projects

- [ClipHub](https://cliphub.gravityroom.app/): send a Counter-Strike 2 demo, get an edited video of the best plays. A Windows app whose Go pipeline parses the demo, records the plays in the game and edits the video.
- [SocialPro](https://socialpro.es): the website of a gaming and esports agency: creator roster with audience numbers, services, case studies and blog, plus a brand portal and the first internal CRM.
- [Piroboom](https://pirotecniaelche.es): the website of a fireworks shop in Elche, live in production. Its 82 MB PDF catalogue is now a searchable 16-page web reader.
- [Gravity Room](https://gravityroom.app): a free strength training tracker that calculates the weights for your next session, on web and mobile.
- [Honey Encryption Proxy](https://github.com/rechedev9/honey-encryption-proxy): local proxy in front of Claude Code that swaps proprietary names for stand-ins before a request leaves the machine.
- [riskforge](https://github.com/rechedev9/riskforge): insurance quote gateway in Go with Terraform for Cloud Run, Spanner and Pub/Sub. A portfolio project.

## Stack

- AI and agents: Claude Code, Codex, MCP servers, Skills and plugins, Multi-agent workflows, Human approval gates
- Backend: Go, Bun, Elysia, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, SQLite
- Web: TypeScript, React, Next.js, TanStack, Astro, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile and desktop: Expo, React Native, Electron, Rust core with UniFFI
- Infrastructure: Docker, GCP, Terraform, Vercel, GitHub Actions
